title: Mafia Island and Its Whale Sharks
excerpt: Mafia Island, south of Zanzibar, is known for its marine park and the whale sharks that visit seasonally.
body:
Mafia Island lies off the coast south of Dar es Salaam. It is quiet, unspoiled and much less developed than Zanzibar.

## Whale sharks

Whale sharks, the largest fish in the world, visit the waters off Mafia in a certain season, roughly from October to March. Snorkelling with them under strict rules is possible.

## Mafia Island Marine Park

The marine park protects coral reefs, mangroves and seagrass. Good for diving and snorkelling.

## Turtles

Green and hawksbill turtles nest on some beaches.

## Village life

A slow pace, with fishing villages and dhows.

## Getting there

By light aircraft from Dar es Salaam or Zanzibar.

## Responsible

Choose operators that follow the code of conduct for whale shark encounters: no touching, limited time, keep distance.

Read our [Mafia page](/islands/mafia/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
